cases.narrative:
In an interview with law enforcement, Leone confirmed that he had been arguing with McIntosh over the stolen tablet. She had demanded the password for the tablet, which was written in a notebook that Leone retrieved from the closet and threw into the room. Leone’s initial statement was that after throwing the notebook, McIntosh handed him the firearm, but later he explained that he had stolen it from (her) car.

He retrieved the gun from a black-and-red boot inside his bedroom closet while grabbing the notebook. He positioned the gun down by his side, concealing it from view. He threw the notebook out to McIntosh, and when she bent down to pick up the tablet or notebook, Leon shot her in the back of the head, holding the firearm with both hands, according to court documents.

“He was angry right before he shot Mcintosh and couldn’t tell her how much he hated her because she doesn’t understand him,” court documents read. “He was mad (that) McIntosh was calling him names.”
